concepts.title: Convergence of a sequence in a metric space
concepts.description: A sequence (xₙ) in a metric space (X,d) converges to x∈X if for every ε>0 there is N such that d(xₙ,x)<ε whenever n≥N.

concepts.title: Metric space
concepts.description: A set X with a function d:X×X→[0,∞) such that d(x,y)=0 exactly when x=y, d(x,y)=d(y,x), and d(x,z)≤d(x,y)+d(y,z).

concepts.title: Nonnegative real square root
concepts.description: For t≥0, √t is the unique real number y≥0 satisfying y²=t.

concepts.title: Metric induced by a norm
concepts.description: The metric induced by a norm on a real or complex vector space is d(x,y)=‖x−y‖.

concepts.title: Abelian category
concepts.description: An additive category with kernels and cokernels in which every monomorphism is a kernel and every epimorphism is a cokernel.

concepts.title: Additive category
concepts.description: A category with abelian-group morphism sets, composition additive in each variable, a zero object and finite biproducts.

concepts.title: Adjoint functors
concepts.description: Functors F:C→D and G:D→C with natural bijections Hom_D(FX,Y)≅Hom_C(X,GY); F is left adjoint to G.

concepts.title: Bifunctor
concepts.description: A functor C×D→E from a product of two categories to another category.

concepts.title: Finite biproduct in a category
concepts.description: An object with injections and projections making it simultaneously the product and coproduct of a finite family of objects, with the usual compatible identity and zero composites.

concepts.title: Category
concepts.description: Objects and morphisms with associative composition and identity morphisms.

concepts.title: Equivalence of categories
concepts.description: A functor with an inverse up to natural isomorphism.

concepts.title: Double-dual functor
concepts.description: The covariant monoidal endofunctor X↦X** obtained by taking a chosen dual twice in a rigid monoidal category.

concepts.title: Dual object in a monoidal category
concepts.description: An object paired with another by evaluation and coevaluation maps satisfying the two zigzag identities; left and right duals reverse the order of the factors.

concepts.title: Endomorphism algebra of an object in a linear category
concepts.description: The vector space End(X), with multiplication given by composition and unit the identity of X.

concepts.title: Functor
concepts.description: A map of categories preserving objects, morphisms, identities and composition.

concepts.title: Splitting of an idempotent endomorphism
concepts.description: Maps r:X→Y and i:Y→X with ir=e and ri=id_Y exhibit Y as the image of the idempotent e.

concepts.title: Isomorphism in a category
concepts.description: A morphism f:X→Y having an inverse g:Y→X, so gf=id_X and fg=id_Y.
